title: Teriyaki tofu with broccoli and brown rice
steps: Cook the brown rice according to the packet.
Pat the tofu dry, slice it, toss in 1 tsp cornflour and fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Steam the broccoli florets for 4 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, ginger, garlic, remaining cornflour and 4 tbsp water, pour into the pan and glaze the tofu.
Serve with the rice and broccoli and sprinkle with sesame and spring onion.
